clue.text: Workers, mature members of the household

parts.note: workers are the men on a factory floor
to mature is to age

explanation.surface: Grown-up workers count as members of the family home.
explanation.definitionFit: A ménage is a domestic establishment, the people living together under one roof.

clue.text: Scruffy little fellow rendering Indian music, something nice at teatime?

parts.note: a raga is a pattern of notes in classical Indian music
a muffin is a bready cake eaten toasted at British afternoon tea

explanation.surface: A scruffy lad performs Indian music, which might be a treat at teatime.
explanation.definitionFit: A ragamuffin is a ragged, dirty child or urchin in tattered clothes.

clue.text: Horse in shaggy dog story?

definitions.meaning: a long rambling joke, here taken as a stale old tale told too often

explanation.surface: A horse appearing in a rambling joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Chestnut names both a reddish-brown horse and an old, overfamiliar joke or story.

clue.text: Bill the blogger?

definitions.meaning: a bill is a printed notice stuck on a wall
someone who puts up posts online, read literally

explanation.surface: Is Bill the person who writes that blog?
explanation.definitionFit: A bill is a placard pasted up, and one who posts online could be so named.

clue.text: Compiler's not right, unsound — controversial debate?

indicators.note: something unsound is not in good order, so the letters are rearranged
not tells us to leave out the letter for right

parts.note: the word compiler's taken with its S

explanation.surface: The setter, wrong and unreliable, stirs up an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not right' removes R from COMPILERS to leave COMPILES, which 'unsound' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Polemics are fierce arguments or disputes, the art of contentious debate.

clue.text: Attended a glittering performance and was knocked out?

definitions.meaning: watched a show full of celebrities
a cartoon blow to the head makes one see stars circling

explanation.surface: Went to a star-studded show and was floored by it.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing stars is both watching celebrities and the dazed vision after being struck unconscious.

clue.text: Engendered plump cattle full of energy

parts.note: plump means fat

indicators.note: full of means the cattle word holds the energy letter

parts.note: a herd is a group of cattle
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Fat, lively cows produced offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: To father is to beget or engender a child.

clue.text: In the course of tour is king put in jeopardy?

indicators.note: in the course of means the letters run within the following words

explanation.surface: Does a king endanger himself while on tour?
explanation.definitionFit: To risk something is to expose it to danger or put it at stake.

clue.text: To defeat hell, the first thing for heaven

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, hence hell

indicators.note: the first thing for a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Beating hell is the first step towards heaven.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pits hell against heaven, but 'heaven' only gives its opening letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To dish an opponent is informally to ruin or defeat them.

clue.text: Like healthy food wife provided in pub

indicators.note: provided in means the wife letter is placed within the pub word

parts.note: a local is one's neighbourhood pub

explanation.surface: Healthy dishes the wife ordered at the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Low-calorie food is a hallmark of dieting and healthy eating.

clue.text: Leading character with baton helps members of the band

indicators.note: the leading character of a word is its first letter

parts.note: helps means assists

explanation.surface: A conductor with a baton helps the orchestra's players.
explanation.walkthrough: The baton suggests a conductor, but only its first letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Bassists play the bass guitar or double bass in a band.

clue.text: Gin in thermos, maybe

parts.note: the word ... or rearranged, can give thermos

explanation.surface: Gin kept in a flask, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as wordplay: MOTHERS 'ruined' (scrambled) gives THERMOS, the word in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Mother's ruin is an old British slang name for gin.

clue.text: Appellation possessed by Anna but not Amanda

definitions.meaning: a name such as a middle name

definitions.text: possessed by Anna but not Amanda
definitions.meaning: Anna has two Ns while Amanda has only one, so the later N belongs only to Anna

explanation.surface: A name that Anna has but Amanda lacks.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a middle name; the trick is reading SECOND N in the letters of the names.
explanation.definitionFit: A second name is a middle name or surname, an appellation after the first name.

clue.text: A contemptible person supporting UKIP's latest political disinformation?

parts.note: a git is a British slang term for a contemptible person
supporting means pro, in favour of

indicators.note: the latest letter of a word is its last

explanation.surface: A nasty piece of work backing UKIP's newest propaganda.
explanation.walkthrough: UKIP is a British right-wing party; only its last letter, P, is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitprop is political propaganda, especially in art or literature, often slanted.

clue.text: Mineral one extracted from areas of land — what you'd expect

indicators.note: extracted from means a letter is taken out of the land word

parts.note: fields are areas of land
I is the Roman numeral one
par is the normal or expected standard

explanation.surface: A mineral mined from the fields, just as you'd predict.
explanation.definitionFit: Feldspar is a common rock-forming mineral group of aluminium silicates.

clue.text: Debilitating condition scaring you — for medic then to get sorted

indicators.note: letters that get sorted are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A frightening illness that you must take to a doctor to be dealt with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get sorted' rearranges all the letters of SCARING YOU FOR MEDIC THEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Chronic fatigue syndrome is a long-term illness of extreme exhaustion, also called ME.

clue.text: Old farm worker's boorish type, two articles admitted

indicators.note: admitted means let inside, so the articles go within the boorish word

parts.note: a nerd is an awkward, socially inept type
A and THE are the indefinite and definite articles

explanation.surface: An old farmhand is a lout who let a couple of things in.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's in 'worker's' stands for 'is', linking definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A neatherd was a cowherd, someone who tended cattle in former times.

clue.text: See 15
Proclaimed a religious woman third-rate, ab'orred on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio means as heard by a listener

parts.note: A NUN, C for third-rate and 'ATED, abhorred with its H dropped as a Cockney would

explanation.surface: Declared a nun to be third-rate and hateful, in broadcast speech.
explanation.walkthrough: C is a third-class grade; the apostrophe in ab'orred signals the dropped H, giving 'ATED.
explanation.definitionFit: To annunciate is to announce or proclaim, as in the Annunciation to Mary.

clue.text: Where fruity type may end up in difficulty

definitions.text: Where fruity type may end up
definitions.meaning: fruit is boiled down and ends up as preserve
in trouble or a tight spot

explanation.surface: Where a fruit-lover might end up in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a jam means being stuck in a tricky situation, and fruit becomes jam.

clue.text: Agreement to omit introduction at start of second book

indicators.note: the opening letter of the agreement word is dropped

parts.note: a pact is an agreement

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: An agreement leaving out its preamble at the beginning of a second volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts of the Apostles is a book of the New Testament.

clue.text: Shock when bird is heard

indicators.note: is heard means the word is spoken and we take its sound

parts.note: a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A jolt of surprise when a bird is heard calling.
explanation.definitionFit: A turn is a sudden fright, as in giving someone quite a turn.

clue.text: Sort of lying that hurts is concealed in jargon

indicators.note: is concealed in means placed inside the jargon word

parts.note: cant is the jargon of a particular group
ouch is what one says when something hurts

explanation.surface: A painful kind of deceit hidden in technical language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying' suggests telling untruths, but it means lying down.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry, couchant describes an animal lying down with its head raised.

clue.text: Ruler given role when overthrown

indicators.note: overthrown means turned over, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: a part is an actor's role
as can mean when

explanation.surface: A ruler given a part when he has been toppled.
explanation.definitionFit: A satrap was a provincial governor in ancient Persia, hence a subordinate ruler.

clue.text: See 15
The head could be one for taking forty winks

explanation.surface: The head of the household could be one for a quick snooze.
explanation.definitionFit: Napper is old slang for the head, and also simply means one who naps.
